# VPadConnect 0.2.1 Beta 2

This release adds a self-contained Windows installer. Download
`VPadConnect-Setup.exe`; Python and a separate ViGEmBus download are not
required.

## What's new

- Inno Setup requests administrator approval, lets you choose the installation
  folder, creates a Start Menu shortcut, and offers a Desktop shortcut and a
  launch option.
- The installer detects a working ViGEmBus installation and installs the
  bundled official ViGEmBus 1.22.0 setup when the driver is missing.
- Setup waits for the driver installer, checks service and Plug and Play state,
  and reports failure or a possible restart requirement. Windows is never
  restarted automatically.
- Upgrades reuse the prior install folder and close VPadConnect before replacing
  its executable. Uninstall removes the application but preserves user data and
  never removes ViGEmBus.
- Installed builds store settings, profiles, logs, and Web Companion keys in
  `%LOCALAPPDATA%\VPadConnect`. Existing legacy data is copied without replacing
  conflicts or deleting the original files.
- The installer includes the ViGEmBus BSD 3-Clause license notice.

## Requirements and limitations

- Windows 10 or later, 64-bit x64.
- Administrator approval is needed for setup and driver installation.
- ViGEmBus was retired on November 2, 2023; version 1.22.0 is its final release
  and will not receive upstream updates. Compatibility with future Windows
  releases is not guaranteed.
- If driver setup fails, virtual Xbox/XInput output is unavailable until the
  driver is installed or repaired. Mouse controls, hotkeys, and Web Companion
  remain available. A restart may be required after driver installation.
- VPadConnect is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nefarius Software Solutions
  e.U. Uninstalling VPadConnect does not remove the shared ViGEmBus driver.

## Validation

- `python -m compileall -q core ui tests main.py` — passed.
- `python -m pytest -q` — 100 passed.
- `node --check ui/web/static/app.js` — passed.
- `node --test tests/test_web_frontend.cjs` — 32 passed.
- The PyInstaller executable and Inno Setup installer compiled successfully.
  The installer embeds the official ViGEmBus binary whose SHA-256 and
  Authenticode signature were verified.
- Mocked Windows orchestration tests passed for existing driver, install
  success, install failure, and restart-needed paths.
- Windows Sandbox was disabled in the build environment. The installer was not
  installed or uninstalled on the host because doing so could invoke the
  kernel-driver installer; interactive destination-page, shortcut, upgrade,
  uninstall, and real-driver scenarios therefore remain unverified.
- The driver command-line switches match the Microsoft WinGet manifest, but the
  official ViGEmBus installer was not executed in this environment.
